headlines.title: 央行：二季度末金融机构人民币各项贷款余额282.63万亿元
headlines.summary: 7月28日，中国人民银行公布数据显示，2026年二季度末，金融机构人民币各项贷款余额282.63万亿元，同比增长5.2%，上半年人民币贷款增加10.72万亿元。企事业单位贷款增长平稳，工业中长期贷款总体平稳增长，普惠小微贷款保持增长，绿色贷款稳步增长，涉农贷款增长较为平稳，房地产贷款有所放缓，贷款支持科创企业力度保持稳定，住户经营性贷款同比小幅增长。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Financial institutions' total RMB loans outstanding at 282.63 trillion yuan at end of Q2
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, the People's Bank of China released data showing that at the end of Q2 2026, financial institutions' outstanding RMB loans stood at 282.63 trillion yuan, up 5.2% year-on-year, with an increase of 10.72 trillion yuan in the first half. Corporate loans grew steadily, medium- and long-term industrial loans rose steadily, inclusive小微 loans maintained growth, green loans increased steadily, agricultural loans grew relatively steadily, real estate loans slowed, loan support for tech firms stayed stable, and household business loans grew slightly year-on-year. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Domestic and foreign currency industrial medium- and long-term loans outstanding at 27.81 trillion yuan at end of Q2, up 5.9% YoY
headlines.summary_en: According to PBOC statistics, at the end of Q2 2026, domestic and foreign currency medium- and long-term industrial loans stood at 27.81 trillion yuan, up 5.9% year-on-year, 0.8 percentage points higher than total loans, increasing by 1.21 trillion yuan in H1. headlines.summary_en: According to PBOC statistics, at end-Q2 2026, RMB real estate loans were 50.74 trillion yuan, down 4.9% year-on-year, decreasing by 1.23 trillion yuan in H1. At end-Q2 2026, real estate development loans were 12.65 trillion yuan, down 8.5% year-on-year, decreasing by 540.2 billion yuan in H1. headlines.summary_en: According to PBOC statistics, at end-Q2 2026, domestic and foreign currency household loans were 82.91 trillion yuan, down 1.3% year-on-year, decreasing by 367.4 billion yuan in H1. headlines.summary: 中国人民银行上海总部发布2026年上半年长三角地区货币信贷运行情况。6月末，长三角地区本外币各项存款余额91.89万亿元，同比增长8.3%。其中，人民币存款余额88.8万亿元，同比增长8.2%；外币存款余额4545亿美元，同比增长14.4%。

headlines.summary_en: The PBOC Shanghai Head Office released the monetary and credit operations for the Yangtze River Delta region in H1 2026. At end-June, domestic and foreign currency deposits in the region were 91.89 trillion yuan, up 8.3% year-on-year. Among them, RMB deposits were 88.8 trillion yuan, up 8.2%; foreign currency deposits were $454.5 billion, up 14.4%.

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.

headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现已成为香港写字楼资产的最大海外买家
headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际表示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产非本地买家中最大的群体，因香港写字楼板块低迷导致不良资产价格大幅回调，吸引了这些投资者。鉴于写字楼资产价格的走势，未来几个月新加坡的需求有望保持稳定。

headlines.title: 商务部：从中国的发展实际看，工业产能利用率总体处于合理区间
headlines.summary: 国新办就所谓“产能过剩”问题中方立场有关情况举行新闻发布会。商务部政策研究室主任林卫龙表示，从中国的发展实际看，工业产能利用率总体处于合理区间。2025年规模以上工业产能利用率为74.4%，高技术制造业、高端装备制造业、战略性新兴产业等领域，产能利用更为充分；原材料等部分传统行业产能利用率阶段性偏低，主要是结构调整、绿色转型带来的适应性调整，属于产业提质升级过程中的正常现象。中国工业整体上供需基本平衡、运行态势平稳。（界面）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: From China's development reality, industrial capacity utilization is generally within a reasonable range
headlines.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on China's stance on so-called 'overcapacity,' Lin Weilong, Director of the Policy Research Office of the Ministry of Commerce, stated that from China's development reality, industrial capacity utilization is generally within a reasonable range. In 2025, capacity utilization for industrial enterprises above designated size was 74.4%, with high-tech manufacturing, high-end equipment manufacturing, and strategic emerging industries having fuller use; lower utilization in traditional sectors like raw materials was due to structural adjustment and green transformation, normal during quality upgrades. China's industrial sector overall has balanced supply and demand and stable operations. (Interface)

headlines.title_en: ChiNext opens lower and falls over 7%, computing hardware and semiconductor sectors slump
headlines.summary_en: 1. Overall trend: The market opened low and fell throughout the day, with all three major indices dropping. By close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.16%, the Shenzhen Component fell 4.52%, and the ChiNext fell 7.35%. 2. Sectors: Liquor, dairy, auto manufacturing, and digital currency led gains; computing hardware, semiconductor chips, coal, and precious metals led losses. 3. Brain-computer interface stocks extended gains, with Innovation Medical, Hainan Haiyao, and Nanjing Panda all hitting consecutive limit-ups. Bank stocks rose, with China Construction Bank hitting a record high, Agricultural Bank and ICBC up about 3%. headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Claim that 'insufficient domestic demand leads to overcapacity' does not align with facts
headlines.summary_en: Lin Weilong, Director of the Policy Research Office of the Ministry of Commerce, responded to claims that 'insufficient domestic demand leads to overcapacity.' He said this view does not match the facts. China is both a manufacturing and consumption powerhouse. Domestic demand has always been the main engine of China's economy, contributing an average of 93% to economic growth from 2013 to 2024, with consumption and investment contributing 55% and 38% respectively. Total retail sales of consumer goods grew from 23.8 trillion yuan in 2013 to 50.1 trillion yuan in 2025, doubling in scale. By World Bank purchasing power parity, in 2025, China's retail sales were about 1.7 times that of the U.S., making it the world's largest consumer goods market. headlines.summary: 财政部、税务总局发布关于调整部分能源资源行业企业城镇土地使用税政策的公告：一、对按《国家税务局关于电力行业征免土地使用税问题的规定》〔（89）国税地字第013号〕等文件（具体见附件）规定减免城镇土地使用税的土地，自2026年9月1日至2027年8月31日，按应纳税额减半征收城镇土地使用税；自2027年9月1日起，全额征收城镇土地使用税，（89）国税地字第013号等文件同时废止。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: Adjust urban land use tax policies for some energy and resource industry enterprises
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration issued an announcement adjusting urban land use tax policies for some energy and resource industry enterprises: 1. For land previously exempt from urban land use tax under documents like the State Taxation Bureau's 'Provisions on Tax Exemption for Power Industry Land Use Tax' (89 Guoshui Di Zi No. 13, see appendix), from September 1, 2026 to August 31, 2027, the tax shall be levied at half the amount due; from September 1, 2027, the tax shall be levied in full, and documents like (89) Guoshui Di Zi No. 13 will be abolished simultaneously.

headlines.title: 商务部：中国从不刻意追求贸易顺差
headlines.summary: 国新办就所谓“产能过剩”问题中方立场有关情况举行新闻发布会。商务部对外贸易司负责人贺少军表示，中国从不刻意追求贸易顺差，我们将继续积极推动进出口平衡发展，持续向全世界开放市场，坚定不移扩大进口。今年上半年，中国货物贸易进口增速为22.1%，明显快于出口。中国稳居全球第二大进口市场，超大规模的市场需求为贸易伙伴提供了强劲发展动力。特别是去年以来，我们打造“出口中国”品牌，计划每年举办超过100场进口促进活动，致力于与全球共享中国发展新机遇。在多国举办的“出口中国”境外活动上，许多中国企业与当地企业签订意向采购合同，拓宽了进口采购来源，为各国企业进入中国市场

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China never deliberately pursues trade surplus
headlines.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on China's stance on so-called 'overcapacity,' He Shaojun, an official from the Ministry of Commerce's Department of Foreign Trade, stated that China never deliberately pursues trade surpluses and will continue to promote balanced import-export development, open its market to the world, and steadfastly expand imports. In H1 2026, China's goods trade import growth was 22.1%, significantly faster than exports. China remains the world's second-largest import market, with its vast market demand providing strong development momentum for trading partners. Since last year, we have created the 'Export to China' brand, planning to hold over 100 import promotion events annually, committed to sharing China's new development opportunities globally. At overseas 'Export to China' events in many countries, numerous Chinese companies signed意向 procurement contracts with local firms, broadening import sources and facilitating market access for foreign companies.

headlines.summary_en: [PBOC: At end-Q2, consumer loans excluding individual housing loans stood at 20.83 trillion yuan, down 1.7% year-on-year] The PBOC released the Q2 2026 financial institution loan投向 statistical report. headlines.title: 部分能源资源行业企业城镇土地使用税政策将调整
headlines.summary: 财政部、税务总局7月28日对外发布公告，明确将调整部分能源资源行业企业城镇土地使用税政策。 根据此次发布的公告，此前出台的煤炭、矿山、油气、建材、电力等行业企业的部分主要生产经营用地免征城镇土地使用税优惠政策将取消；同时，上述企业中具有公益性、安全保障性质以及重大基础设施用地的免税政策将予以保留。

headlines.title_en: Urban land use tax policy to be adjusted for some energy and resource enterprises
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, the Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration announced adjustments to urban land use tax policies for some energy and resource industry enterprises. According to the announcement, previous tax exemption policies for major production and operation land of coal, mining, oil and gas, building materials, and power enterprises will be abolished, while tax exemptions for public welfare, safety, and major infrastructure land of these enterprises will be retained.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China's rapid industrial development provides high-quality, high-efficiency, high-value products globally
headlines.summary_en: Today, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where MOFCOM introduced China's stance on the so-called 'overcapacity' issue and answered questions. The press conference stated that China's industrial development serves as a booster for improving the livelihoods of people worldwide, as its rapid industrial growth provides global markets with high-quality, high-efficiency, and cost-effective products, offering consumers in various countries more stable and diverse choices.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Chinese products meet production and living needs of various countries, offering more choices for consumers worldwide
headlines.summary_en: At a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, MOFCOM introduced China's position on the so-called 'overcapacity' issue and answered questions. headlines.title: 商务部谈贸易顺差：处于国际公认合理范围内，并未出现显著国际收支失衡
headlines.summary: 商务部对外贸易司负责人贺少军表示，顺差反映出国际分工的深刻演变。回顾全球经济发展史，各国在工业化进程中普遍经历了贸易顺差的阶段，英国、美国、日本、德国等制造强国都曾长期保持贸易顺差。从行业产品看，美国芯片80%用于出口，波音公司交付的商用飞机约2/3销往北美以外的客户。欧盟的汽车、药品、化妆品，2025年顺差分别为922亿、2146亿和116亿美元。出口多、顺差大不等于产能过剩。中国实现贸易顺差，反映出中国的产业体系完备高效，是全球分工体系和贸易格局变化的客观结果。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce says trade surplus within internationally recognized reasonable range, no significant balance-of-payments imbalance
headlines.summary_en: He Shaojun, from the Ministry of Commerce's Department of Foreign Trade, said that trade surpluses reflect deep shifts in the international division of labor. Looking at global economic history, countries generally experienced trade surpluses during industrialization, with manufacturing powerhouses like the UK, US, Japan, and Germany maintaining long-term surpluses. By product, 80% of US chips are exported, and about two-thirds of Boeing's commercial aircraft deliveries go to non-North American customers. In 2025, the EU had surpluses of €92.2 billion in autos, €214.6 billion in pharmaceuticals, and €11.6 billion in cosmetics. More exports and larger surpluses do not equate to overcapacity. China's trade surplus reflects its complete and efficient industrial system, an objective result of changes in the global division of labor and trade patterns.

headlines.title: 商务部：人工智能相关产品成为中国外贸“新名片”

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: AI-related products become China's new 'calling card' for foreign trade
headlines.summary_en: Deputy Director He Shaojun of the MOFCOM Department of Foreign Trade stated at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 28th that, based on customs statistics, China's exports of AI-related products such as industrial robots and 3D printers saw strong performance in the first half of the year, with year-on-year increases of 18.6% and 109.3% respectively, becoming new highlights of China's foreign trade. (Xinhua News Agency)
